subject: Draft MAP & condensed evaluation timeline for Omnicorp pilot
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@omnicorp.com>
Cc: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 09:12:00 +0000
Subject: Draft MAP & condensed evaluation timeline for Omnicorp pilot

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Per our discussion I attached a lightweight Mutual Action Plan (MAP) template and sketched a condensed evaluation timeline that aligns to Omnicorp's target decision window. High level:

- Goal: 30-day pilot to validate inference latency and unit-cost targets for search-ranking use case
- Success criteria: <= 120ms median generation latency at 1k qps emulation, embedding cosine recall >= 0.92 on holdout prompts, operational cost < $0.40/1k tokens estimated

Next steps I propose (and I added these to the attached MAP doc):
1) Shared GDoc with owners & milestones (link below) — please assign an internal owner for each milestone
2) Data access: sample dataset delivery (SFTP) by Aug 3
3) Trial infra: Redwood will stand up a dedicated test pool and a sandboxed Private control plane on our EU region
4) Eval run & results review: Aug 10–20
5) Decision: Aug 24 (contracting/POC close)

Link to draft MAP (editable): https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a2b3c-redwood-map-template
Doc attachments: redwood_map_template_v1.gdoc (live), omnicorp-eval-timeline-v2.xlsx (spreadsheet with milestones)

If you want a tighter cadence we can compress the data handoff and early validation into the week of Aug 3. Would you and Samir be available for a 30-minute alignment call on Thu Jul 30 or Fri Jul 31?

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0142

P.S. Monica (CS) and Nikhil (Solutions) are CC'd to pick up the tech/ops details.
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@omnicorp.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir@omnicorp.com>, Omnicorp Procurement <procurement@omnicorp.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 13:40:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Draft MAP & condensed evaluation timeline for Omnicorp pilot

Thanks Rafael — this looks useful and aligns with what we discussed. A few quick notes: 

- Timeline: we really want to aim for a decision by Aug 20 if possible. Can you compress the evaluation window by 3–4 days?
- Data: Samir will confirm which dataset can be shared. We'll need an NDA addendum for the test data transfer — procurement is CC'd.
- Security: Can you confirm SOC2 report availability and whether the sandbox will be deployed inside our EU VPC?

Availability for a sync: Thu Jul 30 at 10:00 CEST works for Samir and me, does that work for your team?

Elena — thanks for the quick reply and for flagging procurement/security. We can absolutely tighten the evaluation window to meet Aug 20 decisioning; I updated the MAP with a compressed schedule and explicit owners. Highlights of the revised plan (see attached MAP v1.1):

- Compressed timeline: Data handoff by Aug 2, infra readiness Aug 4–6, first validation run Aug 7–12, results review Aug 13, final decision Aug 20.
- Security & deployment: Sandbox deployed inside Redwood's EU region with VPC peering and customer-managed keys; SOC2 Type II report is available — Nikhil will drop the evidence link to your procurement contact.
- Contacts & responsibilities:
  - Omnicorp owner: Samir Patel — data readiness & internal IT
  - Redwood owner: Rafael — project lead; Nikhil — technical onboarding; Monica — post-trial success plan

Action items I committed in the MAP doc:
- Rafael: set up dedicated test pool + provide cost estimate by end of day Wed Jul 29
- Nikhil: upload SOC2 redacted report & deployment checklist to the procurement folder by Jul 29 EOD
- Samir/Elena: confirm dataset and SFTP details by Aug 2

Meeting: Thu Jul 30 10:00 CEST confirmed — invite sent. I'll attach the revised MAP (redwood_map_template_v1.1.gdoc) after Nikhil uploads the security artifacts.

Also: Procurement — we'll plan to share a narrow NDA addendum and a short MSA draft. We can route signature via DocuSign; link for reference: https://www.docusign.com/en/omnicorp-msa-draft

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.com
